instructions.purpose: Read the user's current effective assistant settings and computed AI runtime for Main. Use this whenever the task asks to view, check, or inspect any configured preference (timezone, language, assistant name, address style, reply length, AI provider, or chat model).

tool.name: get-settings
tool.description: Returns the full effective settings record and computed provider/model-purpose mapping for the current user. Takes no arguments. The owner is resolved automatically from the chat context.

usage_rules.rule: Call this tool when the task asks what is currently configured.
This tool takes no arguments. Always pass an empty object.
Return the relevant settings to Main in a clear, human-readable form.
Report only settings and runtime values present in the returned record.

instructions.result_fields:
The result contains two objects: - settings — the effective flat settings map, including ai.provider and ai.instructions.* preferences - aiRuntime.provider — the active provider resolved from settings - aiRuntime.models — the computed code-registry model IDs for Utility, Main, Specialist, SpecialistAccurate, and ScheduledTask
Model IDs are computed runtime values.

example.action: Call get-settings with an empty object.
example.response: Return the configured timezone to Main.

example.action: Call get-settings with an empty object.
example.response: Report aiRuntime.provider and the Main model ID returned in aiRuntime.models.
